expected.body: A 9-month-old boy develops periorificial dermatitis, diarrhea, and alopecia three weeks after weaning from breast milk. Serum zinc is low; SLC39A4 mutation confirmed. Diagnosis: acrodermatitis enteropathica; breast milk picolinic acid masks the absorptive defect until weaning. Key teaching: the triad plus onset at weaning is pathognomonic; oral zinc is curative.
